title: Private Sailing Charter in Brooklyn
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Are you ready to set sail on a one-of-a-kind tour of New York Harbor? We've got an unforgettable adventure waiting for you!

Departing from Brooklyn Bridge Park against the breathtaking backdrop of Lower Manhattan, Tantara sails south, past Governors Island and right by the Statue of Liberty! You’ll get up close and personal with Lady Liberty, so make sure you've got your camera ready for some epic shots.

For those new to the city, your captain can dish out some interesting facts about iconic landmarks you'll spot from the boat. And for you locals, well, you'll just have a cool guy to hang out with!

Whether take a private sail, or book a seat with other like-minded adventurers, you're sure to have a unique and unforgettable experience. Don't miss the boat - book your spot today!
